modules.responsibilities: Read-only parser and in-memory extractor for Bethesda BSA v103/v104/v105 archives with zlib and LZ4 decompression.
Read-only binary parser for Skyrim .esp/.esm/.esl plugins supporting GRUP recursion, zlib record decompression, localized uint32 StringID lookup, and inline text extraction.
Parser and UTF-16LE rebuilder for SkyUI MCM Interface/Translations/*.txt files and parser for MCM Helper config.json files.
Binary parser, AST/opcode usage analyzer, and safe binary rebuilder for compiled Papyrus .pex v3.2 scripts with strict identifier table protection.
Binary parser and rebuilder for Bethesda .STRINGS, .DLSTRINGS, and .ILSTRINGS localization tables.
Groups extracted strings into contextual batches by context_group_id and attaches matching Master Glossary rules and ES-419 style guidelines.
Manages the persistent Master Lore Glossary in SQLite with initial seeding, conflict protection, word-boundary term matching, and JSON/CSV import-export.
Defines 47 canonical Elder Scrolls / Skyrim AE / Nolvus glossary terms and the ES419_STYLE_GUIDELINES dict.

Persistent Translation Memory engine with exact SHA-256 lookup, contextual signature matching, fuzzy similarity search, version history, inconsistency detection, and strict blocking of community translations.
Read-only detector for Nolvus Awakening 6.0.21, STOCK GAME SkyrimSE.exe PE version, SKSE plugins, Address Library, Dynamic String Distributor, and MO2 profiles.
Read-only parser for MO2 modlist.txt, plugins.txt, and loadorder.txt, resolving virtual file system priorities across loose files and BSA archives.
Deterministic masking (⟦PH_00⟧) and strict 1:1 restoration/verification of engine variables, HTML/Scaleform tags, MCM keys, and control escapes.
Post-translation quality validator checking placeholder integrity, XML/HTML tag balance, Master Glossary compliance, ES-419 neutrality, residual English ratio, and UI length limits.
Generates non-destructive Dynamic String Distributor (DSD) JSON replacement files under SKSE/Plugins/DynamicStringDistributor/<Plugin.esp>/.
Builds and executes non-destructive MO2 mod packages with meta.ini, manifest.json (SHA-256), automatic backups, and rollback.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: In-memory dataclasses exist for batch items and results, but there is no JSON/JSONL serializer/deserializer implementing BatchRequestEnvelope/BatchResponseEnvelope with schema_version, seq_id, and source_hash.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Create exchange schema serializer/deserializer supporting 01_INPUT/batch_<id>_input.jsonl and 02_OUTPUT/batch_<id>_output.jsonl.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: ContextEngine builds contextual packets in memory and Mo2ModPackager writes export manifests, but no generator writes 01_INPUT/batch_<id>_meta.json for Antigravity exchange jobs.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Implement batch_<id>_meta.json generator containing job_id, batch_id, target_model, input_sha256, item_count, glossary_rules, and style_profile.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Exportador de lotes con identificadores estables
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: Format parsers generate deterministic string_uid values and TranslationPipeline persists batch records in SQLite translation_batches, but there is no exporter writing JSONL files to an external exchange workspace.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Implement AntigravityBatchExporter writing 01_INPUT/batch_<id>_input.jsonl with sequential seq_id and deterministic string_uid.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Hashes SHA-256 de entradas y salidas
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: SHA-256 helpers exist for source strings, PE files, VFS files, and MO2 exports, but SHA-256 hashing of batch input/output JSONL files and manifests is absent.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Compute and verify SHA-256 hashes for batch_<id>_meta.json, batch_<id>_input.jsonl, and batch_<id>_output.jsonl.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: No AntigravityFileExchangeProvider exists in src/nolvus_translator/translation/. Furthermore, ConfigManager.save and TranslationPipeline.__init__ block any provider other than 'mock' while PHASE_1_PAID_API_LOCK is True.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Implement AntigravityExchangeAdapter (requires_paid_api=False, is_simulated=False) and update config/pipeline provider routing.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: No parser or collector exists to read 02_OUTPUT/batch_<id>_output.jsonl or 03_STATUS/batch_<id>.done.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Implement atomic JSONL result collector reading completed batch output files from the exchange workspace.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: Pydantic is available and used for AppConfig, but no schema validator exists for JSON/JSONL batch exchange envelopes.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Define strict Pydantic models or JSON schema validators for each line of batch_<id>_output.jsonl.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Comprobación exacta del conjunto de IDs
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: TranslationPipeline checks results_map.get(uid) for each expected item in a batch, but does not verify exact set equality (missing vs extra/invented IDs) at the batch envelope level and still marks the batch 'completed' when items are missing.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Enforce strict set equality (expected_uids == received_uids) and monotonic seq_id verification in Gatekeeper.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: Missing UIDs per batch are detected in pipeline.py and TM deduplicates previously translated strings, but duplicate seq_id/string_uid detection in provider output and pre-batch WorkUnit deduplication before batch creation are absent.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Add duplicate seq_id/string_uid rejection in Gatekeeper and pre-batch WorkUnit deduplication by (source_hash, context_sig).

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Validación de placeholders y variables protegidas
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: VariableProtector masks 10 pattern categories into ⟦PH_00⟧ tokens and verifies exact 1:1 presence, count, and absence of invented tokens or residual brackets.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Reuse directly in Gatekeeper; persist token mapping in local SQLite/vault rather than exposing original tokens in external exchange files.

existing_code_locations: src/nolvus_translator/core/database.py (UNIQUE constraints on string_entries and translation_batches)
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: SQLite tables have UNIQUE constraints on (snapshot_id, string_uid) and (job_id, batch_index), but there is no ingested artifact SHA-256 ledger to prevent re-importing the same output JSONL file.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Record output_sha256 and ingestion timestamp in batch ledger to reject duplicate ingestion of already-committed batches.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Base de datos aislada de pruebas
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: DatabaseManager and ProjectService accept arbitrary isolated paths and tests run in tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(), but there is no dedicated benchmark/smoke-test DB initializer that clones a read-only sample from the production snapshot while locking the production DB.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Add CLI/service helper to initialize an isolated benchmark SQLite DB from a read-only sample of Snapshot #1.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Historial de resultados por lote y modelo
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: string_entries stores only the latest translation and provider_id (overwriting previous values on re-run), and translation_batches does not store model_id or per-model benchmark comparisons.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Add model_id tracking and a benchmark/attempt results table to store side-by-side outputs from Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Opus 5.5.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: __main__.py only launches the Tkinter GUI; no headless Gatekeeper CLI exists yet.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Create headless CLI module (cli.py / gatekeeper) executable outside the Antigravity workspace.

antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: Batch-level synchronous checkpointing and resumption in SQLite WAL is implemented and tested, but recovery of partially written external JSONL files in an asynchronous agent exchange is absent.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Extend recovery logic to inspect external JSONL lines, salvage valid prefix items, or generate a delta micro-batch.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Controles para impedir la escritura en la base productiva
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: assert_safe_write_path blocks writes to STOCK GAME, Nolvus, and MO2 directories, and PHASE_1_PAID_API_LOCK blocks external APIs, but there is no explicit read-only guard preventing benchmark/smoke-test runs from mutating the production workspace_data/nolvus_translator.db.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Add an explicit production-DB write lock (PRODUCTION_DB_READ_ONLY_LOCK) when running in benchmark/smoke-test or exchange validation mode.

antigravity_integration_23_components.component_name: Mecanismos para separar el contenido del juego de instrucciones dirigidas al agente
antigravity_integration_23_components.verified_facts: Strings extracted from mods are passed as plain strings without untrusted-content delimiters or prompt-injection sanitization, and ProtectionEnvelope in memory holds original tokens that must not be written to external manifests.
antigravity_integration_23_components.action_required: Enclose source_masked in strict data-only JSONL fields, add explicit protocol rules in 00_PROTOCOL.md treating source_masked as untrusted literal data, and keep ProtectionEnvelope token maps strictly inside the local vault.
